description: Site readiness of a website for AI search, 100 points in four parts: reach (robots.txt and a live test of the crawlers of ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google, Bing and Apple), readable (text without JavaScript on the home page and up to five inner pages), understood (title, headings, business structured data, contact details) and answerable (question headings, FAQ or article markup, sitemap dates), with a fix per problem.
